Method of Attack: Exploitation of a vulnerability in the WordPress REST API allowing attackers to bypass authentication and edit titles and content of WordPress pages
Defacement of WordPress sites by rewriting page content
Attack Vector: Crafted HTTP requests exploiting the REST API flaw
Indicators of Compromise: Over 1.5 million defaced pages across 39,000 unique domains
Defacement messages visible via Google search by hacking group names
Security alerts sent via Google Search Console to WordPress site owners
